note: These are applicability pre-checks (Chapter V exemptions), evaluated by applicability.py BEFORE any Chapter II rule runs -- see agent PRD §5.2. A match means the listed declarations are not evaluated at all for that package. Do not encode these as ordinary rules with a PASS/FAIL outcome.

exemptions.description: Packages of net weight or measure 10g/10ml or less are fully exempt from Chapter II declarations.
Packages between 10g/ml and 20g/ml are not fully exempt: MRP and net quantity must still be declared even though other Chapter II declarations are not required.
Fast food packed by a restaurant, hotel, or similar establishment for direct/immediate consumption is exempt.
Scheduled and non-scheduled drug formulations covered under the Drugs (Price Control) Order, 1995 are exempt.
Agricultural farm produce in packages above 50kg is exempt.
